question: A team had 216 members initially. This was divided by 3. This was tripled. Then tripled again. She added 43. She removed 187. Her partner team had 95 members. What was the total?
A student had 104 problems to complete. He removed 52. He added 20. This was multiplied by 6. This was divided by 3. He added 37. How many did he complete?
A factory had 48 units. This was multiplied by 4. He removed 124. This was multiplied by 5. Then multiplied by 7. This was divided by 5. His colleague had fewer. What was the total?

Two supervisors, Alex and Maria, manage equipment. Alex had 185 items. She removed 95. This was doubled. She added 45. This was multiplied by 4. She added 26. Maria tracked fewer. What was Alex's total?
A production facility had 141 units. This was multiplied by 5. Then by 6. Then by 7. She removed 120. This was divided by 6. She removed 3050. A backup line had 67 (not counted). How many?
A supplier had 58 items. This was tripled. She removed 18. This was divided by 6. She removed 18. She removed 1. She removed 2 more. What was the final?
A warehouse had 224 boxes. This was multiplied by 8. He removed 1121. He added 9. He added 36. Measured in pounds per box (unit conversion), what was the total?
A worker started with 191 units. She removed 185. This was multiplied by 8. This was divided by 6. This was divided by 4. Measured in hours (time conversion), how many?
Two colleagues, Alex and Jordan, compare totals. Alex had 48 items. This was multiplied by 5. He removed 21. This was multiplied by 6. He removed 1059. Jordan has fewer. What was his total?
A coordinator had 151 tasks. She removed 69. She removed 12. She removed 53. This was multiplied by 4. Then multiplied by 7. A backup coordinator had 38 tasks. How many?
A business had 198 dollars. This was multiplied by 6. She added 9. She added 12. She removed 1202. This was multiplied by 5. Measured in cents (currency conversion), what remained?
A student had 55 assignment pages. She added 41. She added 3. This was multiplied by 9. She added 18. How many pages to study?

A toy factory began with 14 action figures. They multiplied production by 7 times, then by 5 times again, losing 137 figures to damage, and gaining 71 from a returned shipment. What is the final count of action figures?

James started with 182 trading cards. He gained 37 cards, then 58, then 74. His card value tripled overnight. He added 39 premium cards and doubled the total when listing for sale. How many cards does James have?
David collected 85 marbles. He multiplied his collection by 9, then lost 183 to a friend. He gained 28 from trading and another 64 from his cousin. How many marbles does David have now?

A bakery started with 56 loaves of bread. They multiplied production by 7, added 67 loaves, multiplied by 7 again, divided into 3 sections for distribution, and added 19 loaves for reserve. How many loaves are there?

A small shop started with 100 items. They received 34 items, removed 12 damaged ones, added 57 from a shipment, gained 24 more, removed 85 for a sale, and multiplied the price by 8 times. What is the adjusted cost?

A charity began with 218 donations. They received 76 more, had 272 redirected, tripled the remaining for impact calculation, then multiplied by 6 for budget projection. What is the final budget figure?

Tyler started with 199 pages of a novel written. He added 75 pages, removed 41 pages for revision, lost 154 pages in an accident, and gained 63 pages from collaboration. How many pages does Tyler have?

A recipe called for 48 grams of flour. Maria multiplied by 9 to make multiple batches, divided by 3 for smaller portions, added 34 grams for extra rise, and multiplied by 5 for a catering event. How many grams did she use?
A worker had 136 boxes in storage. They removed 2 boxes, then 102 more for shipment, added back 7, and gained 72 from a delivery. Converting to hours of work time, how many hours are represented?

A game began with 13 levels. Players removed 6 levels, then 1 more, then 5 more for revision, multiplied remaining by 7 for difficulty scaling, added 21 bonus levels, and divided by 4 for grouping. How many level groups remain?

An investor started with 219 stocks. They doubled holdings, lost 288 to market decline, quintupled remaining for recovery, divided into 3 portfolios, and added 71 new stocks. How many total stocks remain?
A campaign started with 45 participants. Two participants left, the rest doubled their effort, 12 withdrew for illness, the group multiplied by 5, and regrouped into 5 equal teams. How many per team?

A contractor started with 153 tasks. They added 37 tasks, multiplied total by 5 for crew assignment, lost 453 to scope reduction, and multiplied by 3 for deadline acceleration. What is the accelerated task count?
